Some more questions:

1. Can i play Master Disciplines cards on a vampire in torpor?

2. If a Prince is in torpor, does he vote?

3. Vampire A plays Carrion Crows. Vampire B plays Majesty.
Does Vampire B take 1R or 2R damage from CC?

4. Can i use Goth Band ability to transfer counters from Tomb of
Ramses to Short Term Investiment?

5. Can i use Cat's Guidance to get +1 intercept and use it again
(another card) to untap the same vampire?

6. Vampire A tries to rescue Vampire B from torpor. He is blocked,
he plays Majesty and untaps. Can he try to rescue Vampire C from
torpor? (There are 2 vampires in torpor: B and C)

Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
"Luis P. Duarte" wrote:
> Some more questions:
>
> 1. Can i play Master Disciplines cards on a vampire in torpor?

Yes. The target vampire has to be in any player's active region.

> 2. If a Prince is in torpor, does he vote?

No.

> 3. Vampire A plays Carrion Crows. Vampire B plays Majesty.
> Does Vampire B take 1R or 2R damage from CC?

No. S:CE ends combat before damage resolution. Only
a few cards deal damage regardless if a S:CE is used:
Drawing Out the Beast
Weather Control
Catatonic Fear
Riposte

> 4. Can i use Goth Band ability to transfer counters from Tomb of
> Ramses to Short Term Investiment?

Yes, since ToRIII uses counters now.

> 5. Can i use Cat's Guidance to get +1 intercept and use it again
> (another card) to untap the same vampire?

Nope. Only one reaction card of the same name can be used
by a minion during an action, regardless of effect.

> 6. Vampire A tries to rescue Vampire B from torpor. He is blocked,
> he plays Majesty and untaps. Can he try to rescue Vampire C from
> torpor? (There are 2 vampires in torpor: B and C)

My guess is yes.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Luis P. Duarte" <Luis....@ip.pt> wrote:
> Some more questions:
>
> 1. Can i play Master Disciplines cards on a vampire in torpor?

It doesn't say "Ready", so yes.

> 2. If a Prince is in torpor, does he vote?

No. [6.3.3.2]

> 3. Vampire A plays Carrion Crows. Vampire B plays Majesty.
> Does Vampire B take 1R or 2R damage from CC?

No. S:CE prempts the strike resolution in which the damage from CC
would otherwise occur.

> 4. Can i use Goth Band ability to transfer counters from Tomb of
> Ramses to Short Term Investiment?

Yes, if you do not control the Tomb.

> 5. Can i use Cat's Guidance to get +1 intercept and use it again
> (another card) to untap the same vampire?

Not in the same action, no. [1.6.3.5]

> 6. Vampire A tries to rescue Vampire B from torpor. He is blocked,
> he plays Majesty and untaps. Can he try to rescue Vampire C from
> torpor? (There are 2 vampires in torpor: B and C)

Not if you're playing the NRA rule from the DCI tournament rules, no.
"Encounter to Rescue" is an action type.

Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:



Right. But this rule (NRA) is optional. Officially, it is a tournament
rule only, though usually adopted for casual play as well. If you do not
use this rule, you can repeat the same action type, or even the same
action, as many times as you want unless limited by card text (as by
Delaying Tactics or Change of Target). Most people on this NG will
probably recommend that your group use the NRA rule, as you can otherwise
do some pretty sick things.

Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 20 Feb 1999 Dhar...@yahoo.com wrote:

> vte...@wizards.com (LSJ) wrote:
> > > 4. Can i use Goth Band ability to transfer counters from Tomb of
> > > Ramses to Short Term Investiment?
> >
> > Yes, if you do not control the Tomb.
>
> Hrm. Was there additional errata to Goth Band. The Band says that
> you can take a (D) action to remove a counter from any master in play.
> And since the (7/7?) munging of (D) actions that would lead me to
> believe that you can do it even if you control the Tomb.

Yes, there was errata to Goth Band, Darius Styx, and Powerbase: Mexico
City. You cannot target yourself with these cards. They were issued as
part of the 7/7 rulings.

These 3 cards were designed under the old errata to the (D) symbol. This
errata was removed by the 7/7 rulings, and the (D) symbol now works as
described in all the rulebooks. Sadly, this also meant that the above
three cards, which were designed with the old errata in mind, had to have
errata in order to work as intended.

As far as it relates to the (D) symbol, more errata was removed than added
as a result of the 7/7 rulings. The current (correct) interpretation of
the (D) symbol is preferable for reasons too numerous to mention. I'm not
sure how you feel it was "munged".
